describe: Two examples at the same TSMC monthly release: the VIX/VIX3M ratio and the SOXX closing price. Each includes a US close after the cutoff. The VIX and VIX3M values were read from the listed sources on 2026-11-21, the SOXX values on 2026-11-22.
limitation: No first-publication time was found. TSMC's release and its 6-K carry the date 2026-11-10 and no time of day. Both cutoffs below are upper bounds, so the expected result is resolved under those bounds and is not verified.

cutoffs.source: TechNews article reporting the figure, stamped 2026-11-10 14:30 with no timezone shown (Taiwan site): https://finance.technews.tw/2026/11/10/tsmc-2330-202610-financial-report/

row_sources.yahoo:soxx:close: 2026-11-22 Yahoo SOXX chart snapshot, indicators.quote[0].close, SHA-256 70d87f085d41024734b8b4a9c0bd326567883370836de0646fca15883b956652.

calendar.basis_note: Every weekday in the window. No US exchange holiday falls in it under the standard schedule (Veterans Day, 11 November, is a trading day). The schedule was not opened as a source; each listed date does have a row in both Cboe history files.
